shipping.policy:
Combined Shipping Policy:
We’re happy to offer combined shipping when items meet ShopGoodwill’s combined-shipping eligibility criteria and can be safely packaged together.If the combined-shipping option is available at checkout, please proceed with payment and your items will be shipped together at a reduced shipping charge. If the option isn’t offered, the items must be purchased and shipped separately.
Please note: It is against our policy to override the ShopGoodwill system or create a combined shipment when the system does not allow it.
When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.
Shipping via FedEx:
All items will ship via FedEx. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). FedEx cannot ship to a Military Box, PO Box, or Puerto Rico. Orders with a tracking number assigned on a weekend are picked up by the carrier on Monday afternoon. Any order with items totaling $300 or more will automatically require a signature.

description:

This collection includes a variety of vintage calligraphy and fountain pen sets featuring multiple writing instruments, nibs, ink bottles, and accessories. The sets are presented in different containers, including a maroon box, metal tin, and a wooden artist's box with compartments.

Condition Notes:
The items show signs of gentle use, including visible wear on some components and minor scratches on the wooden box.

description:
Natural Specimen
Quartz Geode Crystal Cluster
Mineral on Green Host Rock Matrix
Approximately 3.5" x 2.5" x 2"
Unsigned
This striking natural geode specimen features a cavity of sparkling clear quartz crystals nestled within a vibrant, teal-green host rock matrix. The exterior coloration suggests the presence of copper-bearing minerals such as chrysocolla or malachite, providing a dramatic visual contrast to the prismatic crystalline interior. This piece serves as a sophisticated organic accent, showcasing the raw geological beauty and complex textures found in natural mineral formations.
Features a well-defined interior cavity lined with translucent quartz crystal clusters
Natural green and turquoise-toned host rock with earthy iron-oxide inclusions on the reverse
Unique asymmetrical form suitable for shelf, desk, or cabinet display
Condition:
Excellent natural condition. As a raw geological specimen, it retains its original jagged edges and characteristic surface variations. The crystal points appear well-preserved within the cavity, and the surrounding matrix is stable with minor natural surface wear typical of extracted mineral specimens.

description:

This collection includes a variety of mineral and rock specimens featuring polished and raw stones. Included are carved sandstone, quartz geode, cubic calcite, amethyst cluster, and a bright blue-green crystal possibly fluorite or amazonite. Additional specimens include geode halves, black tourmaline, clear quartz, polished agate slices, obsidian, and various sedimentary and metamorphic rocks.

- Types of Specimens: Sandstone, quartz geode, calcite, amethyst, fluorite/amazonite, black tourmaline, clear quartz, agate, obsidian, sedimentary and metamorphic rocks
- Condition: Natural variations in color and texture present
- Appearance: Mixture of polished and raw stones
- Sizes: Range from small fragments to larger hand-sized pieces
- Display: Suitable for visual examination and study

description:
Hemingray Glass Company
No. 12 Insulator
Pressed Glass, Aqua Blue, Antique/Vintage
Authentic Hemingray No. 12 glass insulator, a classic piece of American industrial history. Produced by the Hemingray Glass Company, this model was widely used for telephone and telegraph lines during the late 19th and early 20th centuries. It features the signature aqua blue glass and technical design elements common to the era's utility infrastructure.
Embossed "HEMINGRAY NO. 12" on the front skirt
Embossed "PATENT MAY 2 1893" on the reverse side
Sharp drip points along the bottom base edge designed to shed moisture
Translucent aqua blue glass with characteristic manufacturing seed bubbles and swirls

description:
Cross
Classic Century Pen and Pencil Set - Lustrous Chrome
Vintage 1980s, Ribbed Pinstripe Design
This Cross Classic Century set features the slim, elegant silhouette that has defined the brand's professional writing instruments for decades. Crafted in polished chrome with a distinctive vertical pinstripe texture, this set represents the mid-century modern aesthetic that transitioned into a timeless corporate standard. Both pieces feature the signature conical top and twist-action mechanism that are hallmarks of American precision manufacturing.
Polished chrome finish with vertical ribbed pinstripe engraving
Includes original ballpoint pen and matching mechanical pencil
Authentic "Cross Made in USA" stamps on crowns and brand logo on clips
Personalized engravings: "Mrs. Harmon 88" and "To a Special Teacher 88"
Condition:
Excellent vintage condition with minimal signs of surface wear to the chrome finish. The original presentation box is included and is in good structural condition with minor storage wear. The set includes the original guarantee and instruction booklet.

Description:
Discover a unique assortment with this mixed gemstone lot, perfect for collectors, jewelry makers, or enthusiasts exploring natural minerals. This selection includes five distinct pieces: a finely polished agate slice showcasing intricate banding and rich, earthy hues; a rectangular amber piece featuring an organic inclusion; a clear quartz crystal point with natural terminations; a rough reddish-brown tourmaline cluster exhibiting raw crystal structure; and a deep garnet cluster with naturally formed surfaces. Each stone brings its own visual appeal and tactile qualities, whether you're interested in display, crafting, or study. The agate slice is ideal for decorative settings, the amber is prized by fossil and crystal lovers, while tourmaline, quartz, and garnet are versatile for lapidary or educational use. Condition ranges from polished to raw, highlighting the beauty of each gem's origin. Purchase confidently knowing each stone is naturally sourced and untreated, making this lot a diverse addition for any gemstone aficionado.

description:
Natural Amethyst Geode Cluster Deep Purple Crystals Medium 10-15 cm
This natural amethyst geode cluster features deep purple crystals on one side and a rough, unpolished rock matrix on the other. The crystals show good clarity with a rich violet color and vary in size, displaying a layered structure transitioning from purple to clear and white at the edges. The specimen measures approximately 10-15 cm in length. It is in used but well-preserved condition with no visible damage or repairs. There are no manufacturer marks or branding, as this is a naturally occurring mineral specimen suitable for collectors, crystal enthusiasts, or as a decorative piece.

The resulting fossil retains much of the original cellular structure and growth patterns of the source wood, now transformed into a dense, mineralized material. This particular piece features a unique, abstract form with a tapered, beak-like projection that lends it a sculptural quality suitable for diverse display environments.
